# contextforge Provider

Terraform provider for **IBM ContextForge MCP Gateway** gateway management. Manages virtual servers, gateways, tools, resources, agents, prompts, and teams for the ContextForge MCP Gateway service.

See the [ContextForge MCP Gateway documentation](https://github.com/IBM/mcp-context-forge) for more information.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `address` (String) Context Forge gateway address URL (e.g., `https://contextforge.example.com`). This is a URL with a scheme, a hostname and a port but with no path. Can also be set via `CONTEXTFORGE_ADDR` environment variable.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) JWT token used to authenticate with the ContextForge MCP Gateway. Can also be set via `CONTEXTFORGE_TOKEN` environment variable.
